info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Waitlists-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows clients to retrieve the current waitlist for event tickets in a seamless manner. Designed for event organizers and ticketing systems, it enables businesses to manage attendees who have shown interest in sold-out events. By fetching real-time waitlist information, organizations can efficiently communicate with potential attendees and improve event accessibility. Common use cases include monitoring demand and re-engaging customers as tickets become available.
